boxes.name: open_source_projector
boxes.label: Open source projector
boxes.help: Opens a projector for a source or a scene: on a monitor, or as a window

fields.name: source
fields.hint: A source, or a scene (type its name if it is not in the list)

fields.name: monitor
fields.hint: The monitor's number in OBS, counted from 0. -1 = a window

boxes.name: open_source_properties
boxes.label: Open source properties
boxes.help: Opens the properties window of a source in OBS

boxes.name: open_source_filters
boxes.label: Open source filters
boxes.help: Opens the filters window of a source in OBS

boxes.name: open_source_interact
boxes.label: Open source interact
boxes.help: Opens the interact window of a source in OBS (a browser source you can click in)
